summary: This is a JUnit test class for the smart thermostat, with one small test per behavior: each of the three statuses in regular mode, each of them again in eco mode, and the display string. Each test builds its own Thermostat and makes a single assertion.

lines.text: The method name states the condition and the expected result, so a failure report tells you what broke without you having to read the body.
Every test creates its own thermostat, so no test can be affected by a value another test left behind.
One assertion per test is the whole point of the rewrite: when this one fails you know Idle is broken and that Heating and Cooling still work.
Passing true for eco mode is what makes 64 degrees count as cold; the same temperature would be Idle in regular mode, which is exactly the boundary worth pinning down.
Because printStatusToDisplay() returns a String instead of printing it, the full display text can be compared directly in an assertion.
